articles.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,409
articles.summary: A Russian ballistic missile attack on Saturday, January 3, tragically killed two people, including a three-year-old child, and wounded at least 31 others. This devastating incident underscores the severe human cost and civilian impact of ongoing conflicts, highlighting the grave consequences of military actions on non-combatants in affected regions and demanding global attention.

articles.title: NFL Anytime Touchdown Picks, TD Bets & Week 18 TD Parlay
articles.summary: The article delves into the complexities of NFL Week 18, identifying it as the season's most challenging period for predicting "touchdown props." Key factors influencing this unpredictability include critical playoff seeding implications, player incentives, widespread injuries, and unexpected player rest decisions. Aspiring analysts must carefully navigate these numerous variables to make informed assessments during this high-stakes final week of the season.

articles.title: Retired Gen. Jack Keane calls for ‘maximum sanctions’ on Russia after Putin’s ‘bold-faced lie’ to Trump about alleged drone attack
articles.summary: Retired US Army Gen. Jack Keane dismissed Russian President Putin's claim of Ukrainian drones targeting his residence as a "bold-faced lie." Keane suggested this desperate fabrication was intended to undermine ongoing peace negotiations. This incident underscores the significant information warfare tactics employed and the difficulties in achieving conflict resolution amidst such geopolitical tensions.

articles.summary: Netflix, the world's dominant streaming service, is characterized by continuous strategic evolution. articles.title: Russia scores highest Ukraine gains since first year of war
articles.summary: Moscow has continued its aerial barrages on Ukraine, with the latest strike devastating a residential area in Kharkiv. The attack reduced parts of multi-storey buildings to rubble, underscoring the relentless destruction and human impact of the ongoing conflict. This persistent military action highlights the volatile nature of the war between Russia and Ukraine, crucial for understanding geopolitical defence dynamics.
